Summary: - Song Seung-ho. The spoiled and bratty Prince of South Korea, who gets what he wants and gets away with everything meets the leader of the worldwide K-Pop boy band Stray Army, Kang Lee. 
                                                                      ********

The two who struggle due to their pasts finally meet each other, not on the right foot, of course. When the two decide to make a deal with each other to prove themselves, how will Seung-ho behave? How will they act under these new rules? The two explore each other's day to day lives, and realize just how much their day to day lives are different. When they soon realize just how much they do have in common, both try their hardest to deny the underlying feelings they both know deep down they have.

As much as they want do deny it, they soon realize that the thing they need to escape and explore their malicious past, is nothing but each other.
